blind.description: A square-profile column consisting of a sculpted shaft built from neatly stacked rows of human skulls and vertical long bones, capped at top and bottom with segmented square stone slabs. The surfaces are solid, stylized, and continuous without floating fragments or melting. The base rests flat directly on the floor. Colors are warm bone-ivory and tan for the skeletons, with dark brownish-grey stone on the base and capital.
blind.from_above: A square brownish stone cap divided into outer border tiles and a central square slab, featuring small square socket indentations in three of the four corner tiles.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.25 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7 to 7.5 ft tall) and roughly 2 to 2.5 ft wide.
